findings.description: AWS access key ID and secret access key are hard-coded in plaintext in the Lambda environment variables. Static credentials embedded in infrastructure-as-code are exposed to anyone with read access to the configuration or to the function's environment, and they cannot be rotated without redeploying code.

The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches. Executing workloads on a deprecated runtime exposes the function to unpatched vulnerabilities in the runtime itself.
